candidate.title: Recurring cancellation delete sweep runs once per calendar reference, causing redundant deleteEvent calls (O(n) duplicates/404s)
reports: handlecancelbooking.ts:470 — legacy no-credentialid branch moved inside the per-reference loop, issuing m × (number of calendar credentials) delete calls instead of one pass

recurring-cancel sweep in handlecancelbooking.ts (~440-460) was moved inside the bookingcalendarreference loop, so a collective recurring booking with n calendar references runs the full deletion sweep n times, issuing duplicate deleteevent calls for the same events

handlecancelbooking.ts:424-470 — the recurring-event deletion block moved inside the bookingcalendarreference loop but still iterates all credentials and all updated bookings' references, issuing o(k·n) redundant deletion api calls and re-deleting already-deleted events

handlecancelbooking.ts:418 — recurring-event branch moved inside a for (const reference of bookingcalendarreference) loop while its body already iterates all credentials × all updatedbookings, deleting every recurring event n times and producing n-1 redundant 404/410 api calls

handlecancelbooking.ts:~430: the recurring-event deletion branch now runs once per calendar reference inside the new for (const reference of bookingcalendarreference) loop, so with multiple calendar references the same calendar events get deleted multiple times via duplicate api calls

handlecancelbooking.ts:445 — the recurring-event branch (already looping over all user calendar credentials × all updatedbookings) is now nested inside for (const reference of bookingcalendarreference), re-executing the full delete sweep per reference and issuing duplicate/404 provider calls
